_readme: Brawl Meta Knight tuning (Phase 1, Kirby host). Edit, then rebuild the slot:  python tools\build_mk_slot.py [--preset tuning.melee-feel.json]
Same format and sources as experiment\brawl-kirby\tuning.json (tools\tuning.py of the Kirby port does the resolving).
As shipped this file is the identity: Brawl MK's hitboxes/timing/IASA, cast-scaled physics.
MOVE POLICY  "brawl" = Brawl MK hitboxes, timing and IASA | "melee" = keep Melee KIRBY's vanilla script (the host; it then runs on MK's clip) | {...} = blend
HITBOX FIELDS  damage angle kbg wdsk bkb size element shield  plus  iasa (frame number)  and  windows {"2": {...}} (per hit, 1-based)
SOURCES  "brawl" | "melee" (= the Kirby hitbox it was mapped onto) | 12 | "x1.2 brawl" | "+2 brawl" | "-1 melee"
MOVE KEYS  jab rapid_jab_start rapid_jab rapid_jab_end dash_attack ftilt ftilt2 ftilt3 utilt dtilt fsmash usmash dsmash nair fair bair uair dair
nair_land fair_land bair_land uair_land dair_land grab dash_grab pummel throwf throwb throwhi throwlw
ledge_attack_fast ledge_attack_slow getup_attack_up getup_attack_down
tornado_start tornado tornado_end drill_rush drill_rush_air shuttle_loop_rise shuttle_loop_loop shuttle_loop_fall
shuttle_loop_land cape_start cape_vanish cape_attack jumpaerial
glide glide_attack drill_start taunt wait3   (Geno v2 rows; aliases fthrow bthrow uthrow dthrow neutral_b side_b up_b down_b; globs)
ATTRIBUTES  common: gravity weight jump_v_initial_velocity fast_fall_velocity dash_max_velocity air_drift_max ... (CHANGES.json attributes[].name)
+ rapid_jab_window (0 = MK's rapid-only jab), model_scaling
multi-jump: jumpaerial_jump1_vertical_momentum .. jumpaerial_jump5_vertical_momentum (Brawl hops x jump scale)
special hosts (Kirby's code runs MK's specials): speciallw_max_time_in_stone / speciallw_min_time_in_stone (cape vanish frames),
speciallw_gravity (cape air sink), speciallw_freefall_toggle (cape fall-special landing lag; 0 = plain fall)
sources: "brawl" (cast-scaled, Phase 1) | "melee" (Melee Kirby's) | "brawl_raw" | number | "x0.95 brawl" | "ratio" | "zscore"
MK KNOBS ("mk" block): hitbox_scale (1.0: MK's own skeleton, Brawl units), model_scaling (MK's Brawl Size 0.95),
autolink_angle (Drill Rush 365 stand-in in the Pl file; the Geno exe uses LINK), tornado_rehit, drill_rehit (null = Brawl 6),
geno_v1 (write the v1 overlays into geno.json), geno_v2 (v2 states / specials / glide-tornado-drill blocks), upb_glide (Glide | GlideStart),
taunt_stick (stick past this at the taunt press = up / side taunt), wait3_chance (1 in N Wait1 cycles -> Wait3)
name: default
